svg.title: Multi-scale CNN architecture for text classification
svg.desc: Input text passes through an embedding layer, then splits into three parallel Conv1D branches with kernel sizes 3, 4, and 5. Each branch has GlobalMaxPooling. Outputs are concatenated, passed through Dropout, then a sigmoid Dense layer.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What shape is the input to this CNN model?')
sendPrompt('What is a pretrained embedding matrix and why is trainable=True used here?')
sendPrompt('Why use kernel size 3 in a text CNN?')
sendPrompt('Why use kernel size 4 in a text CNN?')
sendPrompt('Why use kernel size 5 in a text CNN?')
sendPrompt('What is the concatenated tensor shape after merging the three branches?')
sendPrompt('Why is Dropout rate 0.5 placed here?')
sendPrompt('Why use sigmoid activation in the output layer?')
sendPrompt('What does the output probability represent?')

svg.text: Multi-scale TextCNN · Functional API · 3 parallel Conv1D branches
